description: This PHP file handles locale settings, user authentication, session management, and access control for a web UI, including handling login attempts, failed login lockout, and token verification.

methods.name: innerIP
methods.description: Checks if the provided client IP is within the inner LAN network, based on server and network interface configurations.

methods.name: get_ips
methods.description: Retrieves IP addresses assigned to a specified network interface.

methods.name: if_type
methods.description: Determines whether an IP address belongs to LAN, cable modem, or router/gateway network.

methods.name: create_session
methods.description: Initializes a user session with locale settings, timeout, and session ID after successful login.

methods.name: getAuthenticationUrl
methods.description: Constructs an OAuth authentication URL with the specified endpoint and redirect URI.
